reason: They want me to pay the item price and their fee before I have anything in my hands, for a new page I have never heard of, and then wait 2 to 3 weeks. I only pay cash on delivery, and for shoes like that I can go to Shorja or Karrada and find something similar today.
objection: Paying up front to a new service. I have heard of girls sending money to online pages and never seeing the item or the money again, and a photo from a warehouse in China does not prove anything to me.
would_change_my_mind: Letting me pay everything in cash at my door when the item arrives, or at least a friend or relative who ordered from them several times and got their items.
